issues.title: Misleading mirrored 9-5 VIN table in MY2007 page
issues.cause: The factory-authored-looking table under WIS MY2007 displays A=2010 and 5-door-only/late trim fields, inconsistent with the year directory.
symptoms: 2007 seller VIN does not match online WIS year/trim table
issues.diagnosis_summary: Treat year-directory VIN table as out of scope; inspect stamped actual VIN, documentation, independent year-correct factory VIN guide, Saab WebEPC build record and engine/gearbox stamping.
issues.correction_summary: Record source-year conflict and defer any part selection until the actual car's complete identity and manufacturer fitment evidence are verified.
limits: Does not prove the car VIN is invalid or counterfeit.
Do not infer the 2010 codes are MY2007 codes.
No automatic VIN decoder or part interchange approved.

issues.title: Shared FA57 name conceals platform-specific transmission and TCM identification
issues.cause: Saab sources assign different engine-adaptation codes to 9-5 and 9-3 FA57 examples, and different TCM engine-letter tables.
symptoms: used gearbox advert says FA57 fits both 9-5 and 9-3
donor gearbox offered solely on five-speed description
issues.diagnosis_summary: Compare original VIN/build, gearbox stamping groups, engine/bellhousing, final drive, torque converter, harness connector and TCM hardware/software by original WebEPC and WIS.
issues.correction_summary: Require explicit manufacturer supersession/application evidence or independent dimensional/system testing before any approved replacement listing.
limits: Different code examples do not, by themselves, conclusively establish mechanical incompatibility.
Same transmission family name is not evidence of cross-platform fitment.
Never rely solely on model year or a merchant listing.
